#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
ScriptDirectory=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd -P)
Settings="${ScriptDirectory}/settings"
Base=$(<"$Settings/base-dir")
AllowedDatabase=$(<"$Settings/allowed-database")
AllowedRole=$(<"$Settings/allowed-role")
AllowedIPv4CIDR=$(<"$Settings/allowed-ipv4-cidr")
AllowedIPv6CIDR=$(<"$Settings/allowed-ipv6-cidr")
AdminDatabases=$(<"$Settings/admin-databases")
AdminRole=$(<"$Settings/admin-role")
AdminIPv4CIDR=$(<"$Settings/admin-ipv4-cidr")
AdminIPv6CIDR=$(<"$Settings/admin-ipv6-cidr")
CommercialDatabase=$(<"$Settings/commercial-database")
CommercialRuntimeRole=$(<"$Settings/commercial-runtime-role")
CommercialAuthorizerRole=$(<"$Settings/commercial-authorizer-role")
CommercialMigratorRole=$(<"$Settings/commercial-migrator-role")
CommercialServiceIPv4CIDR=$(<"$Settings/commercial-service-ipv4-cidr")
CommercialServiceIPv6CIDR=$(<"$Settings/commercial-service-ipv6-cidr")
CommercialMigrationIPv4CIDR=$(<"$Settings/commercial-migration-ipv4-cidr")
CommercialMigrationIPv6CIDR=$(<"$Settings/commercial-migration-ipv6-cidr")
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
validate_identifier() { local Label=$1 Value=$2 Lower; [[ "$Value" =~ ^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,62}$ ]] || fail "Invalid $Label identifier"; Lower=${Value,,}; case "$Lower" in all|sameuser|samerole|samegroup|replication) fail "Reserved HBA token is not allowed for $Label" ;; esac; }
validate_role() { validate_identifier "$1" "$2"; [[ "${2,,}" != amp ]] || fail 'The local AMP superuser cannot be exposed remotely'; }
validate_database_list() { local Value=$1 Item; [[ ${#Value} -le 511 && "$Value" != ,* && "$Value" != *, && "$Value" != *,,* ]] || fail 'Invalid administrative database list'; IFS=',' read -ra Items <<< "$Value"; ((${#Items[@]} >= 1 && ${#Items[@]} <= 8)) || fail 'Administrative database list must contain one to eight exact databases'; for Item in "${Items[@]}"; do validate_identifier 'administrative database' "$Item"; done; }
validate_cidr() { local Label=$1 Value=$2 Family=$3 ExactPrefix=$4 Address Prefix; [[ "$Value" =~ ^([^/]+)/([0-9]{1,3})$ ]] || fail "Invalid $Label CIDR"; Address=${BASH_REMATCH[1]}; Prefix=$((10#${BASH_REMATCH[2]})); [[ "$Prefix" == "$ExactPrefix" ]] || fail "$Label must be an exact /$ExactPrefix host CIDR"; if [[ "$Family" == 4 ]]; then perl -MSocket=AF_INET,inet_pton -e 'exit(defined inet_pton(AF_INET, $ARGV[0]) ? 0 : 1)' "$Address" || fail "Invalid $Label IPv4 address"; else perl -MSocket=AF_INET6,inet_pton -e 'exit(defined inet_pton(AF_INET6, $ARGV[0]) ? 0 : 1)' "$Address" || fail "Invalid $Label IPv6 address"; fi; }
[[ "$Base" == /*/ && "$Base" != *$'\n'* && "$Base" != *$'\r'* ]] || fail 'Invalid AMP PostgreSQL base directory'
ResolvedBase=$(realpath -e -- "$Base") || fail 'Could not resolve AMP PostgreSQL base directory'
[[ "$ResolvedBase" == "$ScriptDirectory" ]] || fail 'HBA renderer path does not match the configured PostgreSQL base directory'
Base="${ResolvedBase}/"
validate_identifier 'primary database' "$AllowedDatabase"
validate_role 'primary role' "$AllowedRole"
validate_cidr 'primary' "$AllowedIPv4CIDR" 4 32
validate_cidr 'primary' "$AllowedIPv6CIDR" 6 128
validate_database_list "$AdminDatabases"
validate_role 'administrative role' "$AdminRole"
validate_cidr 'administrative' "$AdminIPv4CIDR" 4 32
validate_cidr 'administrative' "$AdminIPv6CIDR" 6 128
validate_identifier 'commercial database' "$CommercialDatabase"
validate_role 'commercial runtime role' "$CommercialRuntimeRole"
validate_role 'commercial authorizer role' "$CommercialAuthorizerRole"
validate_role 'commercial migrator role' "$CommercialMigratorRole"
validate_cidr 'commercial service' "$CommercialServiceIPv4CIDR" 4 32
validate_cidr 'commercial service' "$CommercialServiceIPv6CIDR" 6 128
validate_cidr 'commercial migration' "$CommercialMigrationIPv4CIDR" 4 32
validate_cidr 'commercial migration' "$CommercialMigrationIPv6CIDR" 6 128
declare -A SeenRoles=()
for Role in "$AllowedRole" "$AdminRole" "$CommercialRuntimeRole" "$CommercialAuthorizerRole" "$CommercialMigratorRole"; do Lower=${Role,,}; [[ -z "${SeenRoles[$Lower]+present}" ]] || fail 'Every remotely reachable PostgreSQL role must be distinct'; SeenRoles[$Lower]=present; done
[[ -f "${Base}data/PG_VERSION" ]] || fail 'PostgreSQL data directory is not initialized'
Hba="${Base}data/pg_hba.conf"
Pending="${Base}data/pg_hba.remote.pending"
umask 077
HbaNext=$(mktemp "${Base}data/.pg_hba.conf.XXXXXX")
cleanup() { rm -f "$HbaNext"; }
trap cleanup EXIT
printf '%s\n' 'local all amp peer' 'local all all scram-sha-256' 'hostnossl all all 0.0.0.0/0 reject' 'hostnossl all all ::0/0 reject' > "$HbaNext"
printf 'hostssl %s %s %s scram-sha-256\n' "$AllowedDatabase" "$AllowedRole" "$AllowedIPv4CIDR" >> "$HbaNext"
printf 'hostssl %s %s %s scram-sha-256\n' "$AllowedDatabase" "$AllowedRole" "$AllowedIPv6CIDR" >> "$HbaNext"
printf 'hostssl %s %s %s scram-sha-256\n' "$AdminDatabases" "$AdminRole" "$AdminIPv4CIDR" >> "$HbaNext"
printf 'hostssl %s %s %s scram-sha-256\n' "$AdminDatabases" "$AdminRole" "$AdminIPv6CIDR" >> "$HbaNext"
for Role in "$CommercialRuntimeRole" "$CommercialAuthorizerRole"; do printf 'hostssl %s %s %s scram-sha-256\n' "$CommercialDatabase" "$Role" "$CommercialServiceIPv4CIDR" >> "$HbaNext"; printf 'hostssl %s %s %s scram-sha-256\n' "$CommercialDatabase" "$Role" "$CommercialServiceIPv6CIDR" >> "$HbaNext"; done
printf 'hostssl %s %s %s scram-sha-256\n' "$CommercialDatabase" "$CommercialMigratorRole" "$CommercialMigrationIPv4CIDR" >> "$HbaNext"
printf 'hostssl %s %s %s scram-sha-256\n' "$CommercialDatabase" "$CommercialMigratorRole" "$CommercialMigrationIPv6CIDR" >> "$HbaNext"
chmod 0600 "$HbaNext"
mv -f "$HbaNext" "$Pending"
HbaNext=$(mktemp "${Base}data/.pg_hba.conf.XXXXXX")
printf '%s\n' 'local all amp peer' 'local all all scram-sha-256' 'hostnossl all all 0.0.0.0/0 reject' 'hostnossl all all ::0/0 reject' > "$HbaNext"
chmod 0600 "$HbaNext"
mv -f "$HbaNext" "$Hba"
trap - EXIT
echo 'Staged deterministic remote HBA rules and installed local-only preflight HBA'

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

StopRequested=0
VerifierPid=0
MonitorSleepPid=0
PostgresChildPid=0
PostgresChildStartTime=
ManagedIdentity=
ManagedPid=
ManagedProcStartTime=
ManagedPidStartEpoch=
ManagedAttached=0
CleanupComplete=0
Stopping=0

record_stop_request() {
  StopRequested=1
  if ((VerifierPid > 1)); then kill -TERM "$VerifierPid" 2>/dev/null || true; fi
  if ((MonitorSleepPid > 1)); then kill -TERM "$MonitorSleepPid" 2>/dev/null || true; fi
}
trap record_stop_request TERM INT HUP

ScriptDirectory=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd -P)
Settings="${ScriptDirectory}/settings"
Base=$(<"$Settings/base-dir")
Port=$(<"$Settings/port")
fail() { echo "$1" >&2; exit 1; }
[[ "$Base" == /*/ && "$Base" != *$'\n'* && "$Base" != *$'\r'* ]] || fail 'Invalid AMP PostgreSQL base directory'
[[ "$Port" =~ ^[0-9]{1,5}$ ]] && ((10#$Port >= 1 && 10#$Port <= 65535)) || fail 'Invalid PostgreSQL port'
ResolvedBase=$(realpath -e -- "$Base") || fail 'Could not resolve AMP PostgreSQL base directory'
[[ "$ResolvedBase" == "$ScriptDirectory" ]] || fail 'Supervisor path does not match the configured PostgreSQL base directory'
Base="${ResolvedBase}/"
Data="${Base}data"
PidFile="${Data}/postmaster.pid"
StartScript="${Base}start-postgres.sh"
VerifyScript="${Base}verify-postgres.sh"
ExpectedExecutable=$(readlink -f -- "${Base}pgsql/bin/postgres") || fail 'Could not resolve expected PostgreSQL executable'
BashExecutable=$(readlink -f -- /bin/bash) || fail 'Could not resolve Bash executable'
[[ -x "$ExpectedExecutable" ]] || fail 'Expected PostgreSQL executable is not executable'
[[ -r "$StartScript" && -r "$VerifyScript" ]] || fail 'Required startup scripts are missing or unreadable'
TimeoutExecutable=$(command -v timeout) || fail 'GNU timeout is required by the lifecycle supervisor'

read_proc_start_token() {
  local Pid=$1 ProcStat ProcRest ProcState ProcStartTime
  local -a ProcFields
  [[ "$Pid" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && ((10#$Pid > 1)) || return 1
  [[ -r "/proc/${Pid}/stat" ]] || return 1
  ProcStat=$(<"/proc/${Pid}/stat") || return 1
  ProcRest=${ProcStat##*) }
  [[ "$ProcRest" != "$ProcStat" ]] || return 1
  read -ra ProcFields <<< "$ProcRest"
  ((${#ProcFields[@]} >= 20)) || return 1
  ProcState=${ProcFields[0]}
  ProcStartTime=${ProcFields[19]}
  [[ "$ProcState" != Z && "$ProcState" != X && "$ProcStartTime" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || return 1
  printf '%s\n' "$ProcStartTime"
}

read_proc_identity() {
  local Pid=$1 ActualExecutable ProcStartTime
  ProcStartTime=$(read_proc_start_token "$Pid") || return 1
  ActualExecutable=$(readlink -f -- "/proc/${Pid}/exe") || return 1
  printf '%s|%s\n' "$ProcStartTime" "$ActualExecutable"
}

direct_child_owned() {
  local StartTime
  ((PostgresChildPid > 1)) || return 1
  [[ -n "$PostgresChildStartTime" ]] || return 1
  StartTime=$(read_proc_start_token "$PostgresChildPid") || return 1
  [[ "$StartTime" == "$PostgresChildStartTime" ]]
}

direct_child_allowed() {
  local Info StartTime Executable
  direct_child_owned || return 1
  Info=$(read_proc_identity "$PostgresChildPid") || return 1
  IFS='|' read -r StartTime Executable <<< "$Info"
  [[ "$Executable" == "$BashExecutable" || "$Executable" == "$ExpectedExecutable" ]]
}

direct_postgres_matches() {
  local Info StartTime Executable
  direct_child_owned || return 1
  Info=$(read_proc_identity "$PostgresChildPid") || return 1
  IFS='|' read -r StartTime Executable <<< "$Info"
  [[ "$Executable" == "$ExpectedExecutable" ]]
}

read_identity() {
  local -a PostmasterFields
  local Pid PidData PidStartEpoch PidPort ResolvedPidData ProcInfo ProcStartTime ActualExecutable
  [[ -r "$PidFile" ]] || return 1
  mapfile -t PostmasterFields < <(head -n 4 -- "$PidFile")
  ((${#PostmasterFields[@]} == 4)) || return 1
  Pid=${PostmasterFields[0]}
  PidData=${PostmasterFields[1]}
  PidStartEpoch=${PostmasterFields[2]}
  PidPort=${PostmasterFields[3]}
  [[ "$Pid" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && ((10#$Pid > 1)) || return 1
  [[ "$PidStartEpoch" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && ((10#$PidStartEpoch > 0)) || return 1
  [[ "$PidPort" == "$Port" ]] || return 1
  ResolvedPidData=$(realpath -e -- "$PidData") || return 1
  [[ "$ResolvedPidData" == "$ResolvedBase/data" ]] || return 1
  ProcInfo=$(read_proc_identity "$Pid") || return 1
  IFS='|' read -r ProcStartTime ActualExecutable <<< "$ProcInfo"
  [[ "$ActualExecutable" == "$ExpectedExecutable" ]] || return 1
  printf '%s|%s|%s\n' "$Pid" "$ProcStartTime" "$PidStartEpoch"
}

wait_for_direct_child_exit() {
  local Attempt Limit=${1:-80}
  for ((Attempt=0; Attempt<Limit; Attempt++)); do
    if ! direct_child_owned; then
      wait "$PostgresChildPid" 2>/dev/null || true
      return 0
    fi
    sleep 0.1
  done
  return 1
}

terminate_direct_child() {
  local Signal=$1 GraceAttempts=$2 Forced=0
  if ! direct_child_owned; then
    wait "$PostgresChildPid" 2>/dev/null || true
    return 0
  fi
  kill "-$Signal" "$PostgresChildPid" 2>/dev/null || true
  if ! wait_for_direct_child_exit "$GraceAttempts"; then
    Forced=1
    if direct_child_owned; then
      kill -KILL "$PostgresChildPid" 2>/dev/null || true
    fi
    if ! wait_for_direct_child_exit 20; then
      echo 'Owned PostgreSQL child could not be reaped after SIGKILL' >&2
      return 1
    fi
  fi
  ((Forced == 0))
}

terminate_verifier() {
  local Attempt
  ((VerifierPid > 1)) || return 0
  kill -TERM "$VerifierPid" 2>/dev/null || true
  for Attempt in {1..30}; do
    if ! kill -0 "$VerifierPid" 2>/dev/null; then
      wait "$VerifierPid" 2>/dev/null || true
      VerifierPid=0
      return 0
    fi
    sleep 0.1
  done
  kill -KILL "$VerifierPid" 2>/dev/null || true
  for Attempt in {1..20}; do
    kill -0 "$VerifierPid" 2>/dev/null || break
    sleep 0.1
  done
  wait "$VerifierPid" 2>/dev/null || true
  VerifierPid=0
}

stop_unattached_child() {
  local Info StartTime Executable Signal=TERM
  direct_child_owned || return 0
  if Info=$(read_proc_identity "$PostgresChildPid"); then
    IFS='|' read -r StartTime Executable <<< "$Info"
    [[ "$Executable" == "$ExpectedExecutable" ]] && Signal=INT
  fi
  terminate_direct_child "$Signal" 80
}

stop_managed_postgres() {
  local CurrentIdentity PgCtlStatus=0
  if ((Stopping)); then return 0; fi
  Stopping=1
  if CurrentIdentity=$(read_identity); then
    if [[ "$CurrentIdentity" == "$ManagedIdentity" ]]; then
      "${Base}pgsql/bin/pg_ctl" stop --pgdata="$Data" --mode=fast --wait --timeout=25 || PgCtlStatus=$?
    else
      echo 'Refusing pg_ctl shutdown because the PostgreSQL PID file identity changed' >&2
      PgCtlStatus=1
    fi
  else
    PgCtlStatus=1
  fi
  if ((PgCtlStatus == 0)); then
    if wait_for_direct_child_exit 80; then
      echo 'Verified PostgreSQL postmaster stopped cleanly'
      return 0
    fi
    echo 'pg_ctl reported success but the verified direct child remained alive; forcing termination' >&2
    direct_child_owned && kill -KILL "$PostgresChildPid" 2>/dev/null || true
    wait_for_direct_child_exit 20 || true
    return 1
  fi
  if direct_postgres_matches; then
    echo 'pg_ctl shutdown was unavailable; signaling the verified direct PostgreSQL child for fast shutdown' >&2
    if terminate_direct_child INT 80; then
      echo 'Verified PostgreSQL postmaster stopped cleanly'
      return 0
    fi
    echo 'Verified PostgreSQL direct child required forced termination' >&2
    return 1
  fi
  if direct_child_owned; then
    echo 'Owned launcher child changed executable during shutdown; terminating only the captured child identity' >&2
    terminate_direct_child TERM 30 || true
    return 1
  fi
  wait "$PostgresChildPid" 2>/dev/null || true
  echo 'Verified PostgreSQL postmaster was already stopped'
  return 0
}

cleanup_on_exit() {
  local Status=$? CleanupStatus=0
  trap - EXIT
  trap ':' TERM INT HUP
  if ((CleanupComplete)); then exit "$Status"; fi
  terminate_verifier || CleanupStatus=$?
  if ((ManagedAttached)); then
    stop_managed_postgres || CleanupStatus=$?
  else
    stop_unattached_child || CleanupStatus=$?
  fi
  CleanupComplete=1
  if ((Status == 0 && CleanupStatus != 0)); then Status=$CleanupStatus; fi
  exit "$Status"
}
trap cleanup_on_exit EXIT

/bin/bash -- "$StartScript" &
PostgresChildPid=$!
for Attempt in {1..100}; do
  if ProcInfo=$(read_proc_identity "$PostgresChildPid"); then
    IFS='|' read -r PostgresChildStartTime InitialExecutable <<< "$ProcInfo"
    [[ "$InitialExecutable" == "$BashExecutable" || "$InitialExecutable" == "$ExpectedExecutable" ]] || fail 'PostgreSQL launcher executed an unexpected program'
    break
  fi
  sleep 0.01
 done
[[ -n "$PostgresChildStartTime" ]] || fail 'Could not capture the PostgreSQL launcher identity'

for Attempt in {1..200}; do
  ((StopRequested == 0)) || exit 0
  direct_child_owned || fail 'PostgreSQL launcher exited before identity attachment'
  direct_child_allowed || fail 'PostgreSQL launcher changed to an unexpected executable before identity attachment'
  if CandidateIdentity=$(read_identity); then
    IFS='|' read -r CandidatePid CandidateProcStartTime CandidatePidStartEpoch <<< "$CandidateIdentity"
    [[ "$CandidatePid" == "$PostgresChildPid" && "$CandidateProcStartTime" == "$PostgresChildStartTime" ]] || fail 'PostgreSQL PID file does not identify the direct launcher child'
    ManagedIdentity=$CandidateIdentity
    ManagedPid=$CandidatePid
    ManagedProcStartTime=$CandidateProcStartTime
    ManagedPidStartEpoch=$CandidatePidStartEpoch
    ManagedAttached=1
    break
  fi
  MonitorSleepPid=0
  sleep 0.05 &
  MonitorSleepPid=$!
  wait "$MonitorSleepPid" 2>/dev/null || true
  MonitorSleepPid=0
 done
((ManagedAttached)) || fail 'Could not attach to the launched PostgreSQL postmaster'
((StopRequested == 0)) || exit 0

VerificationStatus=0
"$TimeoutExecutable" --foreground --signal=TERM --kill-after=2 90 /bin/bash -- "$VerifyScript" &
VerifierPid=$!
if ((StopRequested)); then
  terminate_verifier
  exit 0
fi
wait "$VerifierPid" || VerificationStatus=$?
if ((StopRequested)); then
  terminate_verifier
  exit 0
fi
VerifierPid=0
((StopRequested == 0)) || exit 0
((VerificationStatus == 0)) || fail "PostgreSQL verification failed with status $VerificationStatus"

CurrentIdentity=$(read_identity) || fail 'PostgreSQL identity was lost during verification'
[[ "$CurrentIdentity" == "$ManagedIdentity" ]] || fail 'PostgreSQL identity changed during verification'
direct_postgres_matches || fail 'Verified PostgreSQL is no longer the direct supervisor child'
((StopRequested == 0)) || exit 0
echo 'AMP_POSTGRESQL_SUPERVISOR_READY'

while true; do
  MonitorSleepPid=0
  sleep 1 &
  MonitorSleepPid=$!
  wait "$MonitorSleepPid" 2>/dev/null || true
  MonitorSleepPid=0
  ((StopRequested == 0)) || exit 0
  CurrentIdentity=$(read_identity) || fail 'Verified PostgreSQL postmaster exited or lost its identity unexpectedly'
  [[ "$CurrentIdentity" == "$ManagedIdentity" ]] || fail 'Verified PostgreSQL postmaster identity changed unexpectedly'
  direct_postgres_matches || fail 'Verified PostgreSQL direct child exited or changed executable unexpectedly'
done
